scope: Independent PATCH2 audio lifecycle code review, mock Web Audio regression tests, supplied PCM measurements, and read-only private capture-script review. No listening or native-browser claim.

lifecycle.result: Active and retiring sample tails plus scheduled UI oscillators are stopped and disconnected before suspension; throttle and duck state reset.
Only new events create effects; a late suspend or resume is reconciled with the newest pause intent.
Old effects are disposed on mute and do not reappear when unmuted; buffers and music configuration retained.
Old combat/UI cleared, actual player damage and death blast preserved, existing ending motif scheduled once, late expiry/shot and duplicate gameover ignored.

lifecycle.result: resetEffects is called before startGame and before audio resumes; ending motif disposed.

lifecycle.result: toTitle invokes resetEffects before audio resumes; browser title-button interaction remains outside this audit.
A pending target.play completion cannot restart the deck after pause.

fixedPlayerDamage.evidence: Actual mock GainNode gain.value, source.playbackRate.value and StereoPanner.pan.value are asserted. Native capture observer now samples the same live fields; its results are not claimed by this audit.
fixedPlayerDamage.limitation: Shared compressor and saturator remain dynamic; fixed source gain does not imply identical perceived final mix loudness.

droneSignalOnly.decision: No blind normalization. Equal duration and peak with differing envelopes/body energy; perceptual acceptability requires listening. Existing files retained.

findingsReportedToCaptureOwner: Initial capture review findings on tone counter, gain read, decode readiness, async resume event loss, missing expiry/title sequences and generic purpose text were corrected in the private recorder and confirmed by readback.
Fatal-hit fixture injects HP 13 and a projectile; grazing/core/fast-core fixtures reset position and combat. Preserve controlled-test labels.
Fast-core screenshot is the closest sampled or first post-damage frame, not a guaranteed exact instant of collision.
Packet timestamps and actual cue-to-PCM matching will be checked separately after the final recording completes.
